notes.title: MAJOR STABILITY UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Major Update Highlights

New Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209033/852da1f91912483ff20727ee11306c15a71deafe.jpg

We are happy to release what we believe to be the first stable update of Blob after a complete behind the scene rework of our exchange system and LOTS of new features and fixes for the additions that happened during the past month! But not to forget the following :


 Items are now tradable on Steam
 New Achievement for completing the Compounds (Alternate) Table
 Added a “Disassemble All Compounds” button (appears only if the Periodic Table is completed)
 Prevent login if Steam is not properly initialized
 Added more translations

Improvements

 Subscripts will now display correctly
 Misc Performance Improvements

Bug Fixes

General Fixes:

 Compounds with more than 5 elements composing them will now assemble and disassemble correctly
 Compounds will not trigger element notification when being made anymore
 One Per Row achievement doesn’t cause a crash anymore

Please join our Discord to report any issues and bugs you may encounter, we’re very proud of this update and await your feedback ːsteamhappyː

Discord Link : https://discord.gg/CTk3MfEBn6

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Minor Update Highlights

New Features


 Added an option to disable auto-claim in the Settings menu
 Added an option to skip menu loading in the Settings menu

Improvements


 Reduced auto-claim delay from 3s to 1.5s
 Massive Performance Improvements
 Research Field will no longer clear after making a compound
 Claim Zones will now show “Reconnecting” if an issue with Steam is detected
 Atoms will automatically Load without lerping on game open

Bug Fixes

General Fixes:


 Complete Table achievement will now complete
 Fixed multiple compounds recipes
 Fixed text formatting on upgrades
 Element will now auto-close if quantity reaches 0
 Fixed some text overflows

notes.title: MAJOR CLICKER UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Major Update Highlights

New Features

 CLICKER UPDATE 

The awaited clicker update is now LIVE in Blob. A store where you can spend atoms (the new currency name) and where your Compounds MATTER.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209033/26430733ce5726b210f59033c1d12f81c87493db.png

We have made significant enhancements and introduced a variety of new features and improvements, as outlined below:


 Added Rows Claims directly on the Periodic Table
 Added “Dropped” label on latest dropped element


Improvements


 Reworked Tutorial to walk players through every step
 Replaced the full-screen blocker with a non-intrusive timer
 All Elements and Compounds will now show a “Sell on Market” button on click
 “Clicks” are now “Atoms”
 Moved Periodic Table close button to the left menu
 Pop Ups will no longer block mouse input
 Counter will now interpolate between values
 Improved Atoms Counter UI design
 Added a Skip Tutorial Button
 Misc Performance Improvements


Bug Fixes

General Fixes:


 All Rows Claimed popup will not show upon making a compound anymore
 Fixed Issues with Tutorial failing to save on some occasions


Please join our Discord to report any issues and bugs you may encounter, we’re very proud of this update and await your feedback ːsteamhappyː

Discord Link : https://discord.gg/CTk3MfEBn6
